lines.zh: 我两条腿踩过草地，很沉
lines.en: My two legs tramp across the grass, heavy.
Three horns rise from my head.

lines.zh: 我走在兽群中间，不落后
lines.en: I walk among the pack, never last.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上拖着痕
lines.en: My tail drags a trail on the ground.

lines.zh: 每一步都能听见草被压折
lines.en: Each step you can hear grass break.
I circle near my anchor point.

lines.zh: 我的头盔在阳光下很亮
lines.en: My helmet glints in the sun.

lines.zh: 草原上，我的角先露出来。
lines.en: On the savanna, my horns show first.
Fresh soil on my claws.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，其他兽让开
lines.en: Others move aside where I walk.

lines.zh: 我慢慢拐向有气味的方向
lines.en: I angle toward a smell.

lines.zh: 走累了，我也只是慢下来
lines.en: Tired, I only slow a little.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，让同伴跟上
lines.en: I growl once for the pack to follow.
I head for the open ground.
I stand on the plain, head raised.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让草轻微摆动
lines.en: My breath stirs the grass.

lines.zh: 我在锚点旁边绕了半圈
lines.en: I pace half a circle by my anchor.

lines.zh: 三只角的影子落在地上
lines.en: My three horns cast shadows on the ground.

lines.zh: 我在听远处兽群的叫声
lines.en: I listen to the pack's calls far off.
My tail sweeps lightly over the dirt.
I don't sit. I stand.
The wind shifts; I turn my head.

lines.zh: 这一片草原够我们活动
lines.en: This savanna is wide enough for us.

lines.zh: 我把前爪在地上压了压
lines.en: I press my foreclaws into the ground.

lines.zh: 我的头盔边缘有点划痕
lines.en: There are scratches on my helmet's rim.
I open my jaws slowly, then close them.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子抬起来，闻风向
lines.en: I lift my snout and read the wind
Something moves in the grass.

lines.zh: 我把头转过来，三只角对着你
lines.en: I turn my head; three horns face you.
You're a good deal shorter than I am.
You stand outside the pack.

lines.zh: 我的三只角一直朝着你
lines.en: My three horns stay pointed at you
I'm judging whether you'll come closer.

lines.zh: 你手里有东西，我不太在乎
lines.en: There's something in your hand. I hardly care.
A breath puffs from my nostrils.
I growl, but you needn't step back.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，这很不寻常
lines.en: You standing still is unusual.
I shift my weight to my forelegs.
This stretch is mine.

lines.zh: 你要留在这里，就得规矩点
lines.en: Stay, and do it properly.

lines.zh: 我低下头，鼻息喷在你脸上
lines.en: I lower my head and snort in your face
This isn't a threat. Only looking.
We look at each other a while.
All right. I'll remember you.

lines.zh: 我甩头，低吼震得草在抖
lines.en: I shake my head and my growl makes the grass tremble

lines.zh: 我的鳞片上多了一道白
lines.en: A white line on my scales.
That hit my shoulder.
I shake my head; my horns still ring.
I lick the split in my scales
Grass flattens under my feet.

lines.zh: 我重新站好，把头低下来
lines.en: I reset and lower my head.
You hit harder than I expected.
The pack calls out behind me.

lines.zh: 疼意窜上来，我压低前身
lines.en: The pain flares and I lower my forebody
You're holding meat. I smell it.

lines.zh: 草原上的肉味，我抵不住
lines.en: I cannot resist the smell of meat on the plains

lines.zh: 我一口吞下，还不够垫牙
lines.en: One gulp, and it does not even fill my teeth
Set it down and step back.
I lower my head and sniff.
This is too lean to fill me
Any more? You'd better have more.

lines.zh: 我抬起头看你，等下一块
lines.en: I look up at you, waiting for the next.
That doesn't tame me.

lines.zh: 不过我会记住这个味道
lines.en: But I'll remember the taste.
Come a bit closer. I don't mind.
Fed, I'll stand still for a while.
You hit my leg and bounce off.
My body barely sways.
That made me turn my head.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩甲上，手发麻
lines.en: You hit my shoulder plate and your hands go numb
I shift a foot and leave a pit in the ground
I settle my weight again.
One more claw print on the ground.
I growl, lightly.
Scorch marks still cling to my horns.
Next time, come at the front.

lines.zh: 兽群里并肩的有好几对
lines.en: Several pairs run abreast in the pack.

lines.zh: 我们一起走，步子会对上
lines.en: Walking together, our strides line up.

lines.zh: 你靠在我侧面，那里有遮挡
lines.en: Stay at my flank. There's cover there.

lines.zh: 我的锚点就在那棵树下
lines.en: My anchor is under that tree.
At night we take turns watching.
If something moves, bump me.
This isn't any kind of vow.

lines.zh: 但我会一直站在这一侧
lines.en: But I'll keep standing on this side.
Tomorrow we go deeper into the savanna.
Just keep up. Don't fall behind.
I only have to lower my head.
One bite nearly crushes it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子夹不住小的东西
lines.en: My claws can't hold small things.
You dropped it. I have it.
I carry it in my jaws a while.
This doesn't taste good.
I spit it out and glance at it again.
Useful things I carry.
Useless things I shake loose.
My jaws don't hold much.
That thing over there has stopped.
I lower myself and move forward.
I'll greet you with teeth first.
This goes for your chest.
You may strike first, too.
The pack follows me in.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落到你身上
lines.en: My shadow falls over you first
Horns and teeth are both out front.
You've backed to the grass's edge.
There's no cover there.

lines.zh: 我把重心前移，角尖朝下
lines.en: I shift my weight forward, horn tips low
I crush a patch of grass and charge

lines.zh: 暴龙兽的角，一步一逼近。
lines.en: Greymon's horn closes in step by step.
Wherever you go, I turn after.
My shadow covers you.
You have a few steps of room.
My tail sweeps the grass tips.
I'm waiting for the pack to get in place.
They've already spread out.

lines.zh: 我的角尖离你只剩三步
lines.en: My horn tips are three paces from you
My horns come down.
My breathing has grown heavier.
One more step forward is enough.
Pressing in right now.

lines.zh: 我的头顶过去，把你掀翻
lines.en: My horns sweep you off your feet.
My teeth clamp your pauldron.
This charge carries my full weight.
You slide across the grass.
My claw presses your chest.

lines.zh: 鳞片撞在你护甲上，很响
lines.en: My scales ring against your armour.
I shake my head and throw you off.
Three claw lines on your armour.
My foreclaw hangs raised again.

lines.zh: 还能站着，很好，再扛一下。
lines.en: Still standing. Good. Take another.
This one will be heavier.
This ends here. My horn is aimed.

lines.zh: 我从草原的尽头走过来
lines.en: I come walking from the far edge of the savanna.
Six of us arrived together.
My three horns show first.
We press a path through the grass.
I take my place by the anchor.

lines.zh: 兽群在我身后，一起停下
lines.en: The herd halts behind me as one
I turn my head slowly and scan.
Sun on my back.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声让鸟都飞了
lines.en: My steps put the birds up.
I take a few steps, then stop.
I step into the grass and the birds scatter

lines.zh: 我把草原的风记在鼻子里
lines.en: I keep the prairie wind in my nose
I don't mean to move yet.
But I keep watching.
The heat makes my scales burn.
I fall and make a crater.
Water in my jaws; I thrash.

lines.zh: 气浪把我撞得横移半步
lines.en: The blast shifts me half a step sideways.
An arrow sticks in a seam of my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 这力量绕过鳞片打进来
lines.en: That force bypasses my scales.
Too starved even to lift my legs well.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，我僵了一瞬
lines.en: Lightning hits my horns; I lock up an instant.
There's no savanna under me now.
